findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_history_packages, get_liquidations, get_liquidations_summary, search_twitter, get_x_user, get_x_user_tweets, get_x_mentions, get_x_tweet, get_crypto_twitter, buy_credits, buy_day_pass, get_api_key, list_alerts · Private data: list_history_packages, get_token_unlocks, get_trader_profile, get_smart_money, buy_credits, buy_day_pass, get_api_key, create_alert, list_alerts, delete_alert, get_detective_events, get_lighter_whales · Public sink: get_microstructure, get_funding_arbitrage, get_oi_board, get_arbitrum_perps, get_liquidation_map, get_precedents, test_rule, get_x_user, get_x_tweet, get_fear_greed, get_prediction_markets, scan_rule, buy_credits, buy_day_pass, get_api_key, create_alert, list_alerts, delete_alert, get_detective_events, get_hip3_markets · Destructive: get_hl_liquidation_map, ask, get_defi_liquidations, explain_market, delete_alert.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
